subject: PoC onboarding: payment cadence, provisional credit cap, and VAT routing
messages:
From: Simon Park <simon.park@helixmed.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixmed.com
Date: 2026-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PoC onboarding: need Net60 and provisional credit cap

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move the 3-month PoC forward. Procurement has two constraints we need to surface before the PO: their standard payment lane is Net60 for pilots, and they require a provisional credit ceiling to be agreed up front for invoicing.

Could Redwood accept Net60 for the PoC invoices? If not, what flexibility do you have on a staged schedule (part up-front, remainder on longer terms)? Also we need the invoices made out to HelixMed UK Ltd (VAT reg: GB123456789) and a note on VAT handling for cross-border services.

I attached our procurement form for your finance team. Procurement will hold the PO until we have a signed SOW and agreed payment cadence/credit ceiling.

Key items Helix needs:
- Payment cadence (Net30/45/60 or split)
- Provisional credit cap for the 3-month pilot
- VAT invoicing details and remit entity
- Timeline for credit check / onboarding

Can you propose an approach by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Simon
Simon Park
Head of Procurement, HelixMed
procurement@helixmed.com

Subject: Re: PoC onboarding: need Net60 and provisional credit cap

Hi Simon — appreciate the clear list. Quick responses and a compromise that usually works for pilots:

Proposal (to enable PO release and keep unit economics reasonable):
1) Invoice #1 (onboarding + first month): Net30 from invoice date (this covers setup & initial usage).
2) Subsequent PoC invoices (months 2–3): Net45.
3) Provisional credit cap: $150,000 USD for the duration of the PoC. Cap can be adjusted after month 1 if consumption is higher and both sides agree.
4) VAT invoicing: we can issue invoices from Redwood EU (Redwood Inference Ireland Ltd) to HelixMed UK Ltd and include the reverse-charge VAT line if applicable. We'll need Helix to confirm VAT number and whether reverse charge applies.
5) Credit checks / timelines: we typically approve a provisional cap within 2 business days once we receive the completed credit application and one year of financials. Final cap after underwriting (5–7 business days).

If you absolutely need Net60 across the board, we can consider that for a purchase-order-backed arrangement but we'd request a higher provisional cap or an initial 25% prepayment.

I've attached a draft SOW and our credit application to accelerate things. Vivek/Marissa — can you confirm finance is OK to provisionally approve $150k pending credit app + basic KYC?

Next steps:
- Simon: confirm VAT number and remit entity (HelixMed UK Ltd), approve proposed cadence OR indicate if PO requires Net60.
- If cadence agreed, we'll send DocuSign SOW + credit app link.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Looping in finance notes so there's a record for procurement:

Stephanie — provisional approval notes from Finance:
- Accept provisional credit cap: $150,000 USD for the 3-month PoC, contingent on receipt of completed credit_application_helix.xlsx and one year of financials (or public filings).
- Approve Net45 on months 2–3 after an initial Net30 invoice.
- If Helix insists on Net60 for all invoices, Finance requires either (a) a 25% deposit on the first invoice or (b) an insured receivable mechanism (we can discuss options).
- Offer: 1.5% early-pay discount if invoices paid within 10 days of issuance (applies to Net30/45 invoices). This helps align incentives with faster payment.

Marissa — please be ready to run a quick credit inquiry once we receive the application.

Vivek
VP Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: PoC onboarding: need Net60 and provisional credit cap

Thanks, Stephanie and Vivek. The approach is reasonable and should get procurement unstuck. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Helix can accept your proposed split (Net30 for first invoice, Net45 thereafter). Procurement has internal policy to prefer Net60 but will accept a staged cadence if finance at Redwood can be flexible on the cap and credit timeline.
2) The VAT reg number is GB123456789 — Eleni (cc'd) will send the certificate and confirm reverse-charge applicability.
3) For the provisional cap: Helix prefers an initial $125,000 USD cap (our internal limit for trial spend). Can Redwood lock $125k provisional with a commitment to revisit after month 1?
4) Regarding the early-pay discount: Helix is prepared to pay Net30 invoices within 10 days if a 1% early-pay discount is applied (1.5% is high for our approval band).

If you confirm the $125k provisional cap and 1% early-pay discount, procurement will release the PO once the SOW is countersigned. We will upload the PO to DocuSign as a supporting document.

Simon
